z-m-19-02.title: Shin akwai ma'aunin murabba'i guda ɗaya kacal wanda mafita biyunsa su ne 2 da −5?
z-m-19-02.topic: Ƙirƙirar ma'aunin murabba'i daga mafita biyu da aka bayar, da sharaɗin da ke kayyade shi ya zama guda ɗaya
z-m-19-02.goal: Ka nuna da misalai da dama cewa ko da an bayar da mafita biyu, ma'aunin murabba'i ba ya kayyaduwa ya zama guda ɗaya. Ka tantance ƙarin bayanin da zai kayyade ma'aunin ya zama guda ɗaya da bayanin da ba sabon bayani ba ne.
z-m-19-02.material: Sua ta yi tambayar gasa. ‘Faɗa min ma'aunin murabba'i wanda mafita (tushensa) su ne ƙimomin x=2 da x=−5.’ Ana rubuta ma'aunin murabba'i ax²+bx+c=0 (a≠0), kuma a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne. (Ana karanta x² da ‘x a murabba'i’, −5 kuma da ‘minti 5’.)
z-m-19-02.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar ko bayanin da aka bayar ya isa
z-m-19-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalai da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗa da gano alaƙarsu
z-m-19-02.thinking.2: Tantance ko sharaɗin da aka ƙara sabon bayani ne da gaske
z-m-19-02.prereq.0: Ma'anar mafitar ma'aunin murabba'i da bincika ta hanyar saka mafita cikin ma'aunin
z-m-19-02.prereq.1: Buɗe ninkar furucin aljebra (matakin aji na 9)
z-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: Shin bayanin ‘mafita su ne 2 da −5’ shi kaɗai yana kayyade ma'aunin murabba'i ya zama guda ɗaya?
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka ƙirƙiri ma'aunin murabba'i ɗaya mai mafita 2 da −5 (misali, buɗe (x−2)(x+5)=0), sannan ka saka mafita don bincika ko sakamakon 0 ne.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada ko za ka iya ƙirƙirar ma'auni mai mafita iri ɗaya amma ma'aunansa sun bambanta da wanda ka ƙirƙira, sannan ka saka mafita don bincikawa.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.a: An kayyade shi. Idan mafita iri ɗaya ne, ma'aunin zai iya zama iri ɗaya kawai
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.a: Ba ka gwada ko za a iya samun ma'aunai da dama masu mafita iri ɗaya ba. Bayan ka ƙirƙiri ma'auni ɗaya mai mafita 2 da −5, ka gwada sauya ma'aunansa.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba a kayyade shi ba. Amma ma'aunai masu mafita iri ɗaya su ne guda biyu kawai da aka sauya alamar a
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.b: Daidai ne cewa ma'aunin ba a kayyade shi ya zama guda ɗaya ba, amma ba alamar kawai ce take canzawa ba. Ka kuma ƙirƙiri ma'aunai da aka sauya girman a zuwa 2 ko 3, sannan ka saka mafita.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.c: Ba a kayyade shi ba. Wataƙila akwai wasu ma'aunai da suka fi haka masu mafita iri ɗaya
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.d: An kayyade shi. Ma'aunin da aka samu ta buɗe (x−2)(x+5)=0 daga mafita biyun shi ne amsar
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.d: Za ka iya buɗe (x−2)(x+5)=0 ka samu ma'auni ɗaya, amma ma'aunin da aka samu ta ninka shi da kowace lamba da ba 0 ba ma yana da mafita iri ɗaya. Saka mafita cikin ma'auni mai ma'aunai daban.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.explain: Idan ka saka x=2 da x=−5 cikin x²+3x−10=0, duka suna ba da 0; kuma 2x²+6x−20=0, wato ma'aunin da aka ninka dukkan sassansa da 2, shi ma yana riƙe da mafita biyun. Saboda haka mafita kaɗai ba sa kayyade ma'aunin ya zama guda ɗaya. A mataki na gaba, za mu ƙirƙiri ma'aunai da kanmu domin ganin nawa ne za su yiwu.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri ma'aunai murabba'i daban-daban guda 3 ax²+bx+c=0 waɗanda duka suke da x=2 da x=−5 a matsayin mafita. (a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne kuma −9≤a≤9)
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka ɗauki buɗaɗɗen ma'aunin (x−2)(x+5)=0 da aka ƙirƙira daga mafita a matsayin farawa, sannan ka gwada irin sauye-sauyen da za a yi ba tare da canza mafita ba.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka rubuta ma'aunan (a, b, c) na ma'aunai da ka ƙirƙira a tebur, sannan ka kwatanta yadda b da c suke canzawa tare da a yayin da a yake canzawa.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma'aunin murabba'i ne kuma ma'aunansa sun cika sharuɗɗan.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a ba zai zama 0 ba, kuma dole ya zama lamba cikakkiya tsakanin −9 da 9; b da c ma su zama lambobi cikakku.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma'aunin yana aiki idan aka saka x=2.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Saka x=2. Shin gefen hagu ya zama 0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Ma'aunin yana aiki idan aka saka x=−5 ma.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Saka x=−5. Shin gefen hagu ya zama 0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.explain: Saka x=2 da x=−5 yana ba da 4a+2b+c=0 da 25a−5b+c=0, kuma daga ma'aunai biyun nan za a samu b=3a, c=−10a. Don haka da zarar an yanke shawarar a, b da c suna biyo baya, kuma ma'aunan da za su yiwu su ne x²+3x−10=0 da aka ninka dukkan sassansa da lamba guda da ba 0 ba.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Wace alaƙa ce ke tsakanin ma'aunan da ka ƙirƙira? Ka rubuta yadda ma'aunansu suka canza ta saka lambobi.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka rubuta a, b, c na ma'aunai biyu daga cikin waɗanda ka ƙirƙira gefe da gefe, sannan ka kwatanta su ta hanyar rabo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Saka x=2 a ma'aunin da aka ƙirƙira ta ninka dukkan gefunan x²+3x−10=0 da lamba guda.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika ko wannan alaƙa ɗaya tana aiki a dukkan ma'aunan da ka ƙirƙira kuwa?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana ko da a layi guda dalilin da ya sa wannan alaƙar ba ta canza mafita kuwa?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan aka ninka gefunan biyu na x²+3x−10=0 da 2, zai zama 2x²+6x−20=0. Dukkan ma'aunai sun ninka da dalili ɗaya, mafita kuma iri ɗaya ce.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.1: A ma'aunan da na ƙirƙira, idan a=1, 2, −1, to b=3a, c kuma =−10a. Na ninka ma'aunin gaba ɗaya da lamba guda, don haka mafita biyun ba su canza ba.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Lokacin da na sauya a zuwa 1, 2, −1, b ya biyo baya a matsayin 3a, c kuma a matsayin −10a. Rabon ma'aunai koyaushe iri ɗaya ne, 1:3:−10.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.prompt: Sua tana son ƙara sharaɗi domin a kayyade ma'aunin ya zama guda ɗaya. Baya ga sharaɗin cewa mafita su ne 2 da −5, zaɓi duk sharuɗɗan da ke kayyade ma'aunin murabba'i ax²+bx+c=0 (a, b, c lambobi cikakku) ya zama guda ɗaya.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ta amfani da alaƙar b=3a, c=−10a, ka sauya kowane sharaɗi zuwa furuci mai amfani da a kawai.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ka ƙidaya ko a da ya cika sharaɗin da aka sauya guda ɗaya ne ko kuwa da dama.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.a: Ma'aunin a na x² tabbatacce ne
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.a: A=1, 2, 3 ... duk suna yiwuwa, saboda haka ba a kayyade shi ya zama guda ɗaya ba. Ƙayyade alamar kawai ba ya tantance girman lambar da aka ninka.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.b: Idan ka rasa alaƙar c=−10a, yana da wuya a gane cewa wannan sharaɗi yana kayyade a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.c: Idan mafita biyun su ne 2 da −5, jimillarsu tuni −3 ce. Ka ɗauki maimaita bayanin da aka riga aka bayar a matsayin sabon bayani.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.d: Jimillar ma'aunai ukun a+b+c ita ce −6
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.d: Idan ka saka alaƙar da ke tsakanin a, b, c, sannan ka rubuta a+b+c da harafi guda, za ka ga cewa wannan sharaɗi yana kayyade a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.e: a, b, c duk ba sifili ba ne
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.e: Idan a ba 0 ba ne, to b=3a da c=−10a su ma ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka wannan sharaɗi tuni ya cika. Ba sabon bayani ba ne.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.f: Ma'aunin a na x² shi ne 1
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.f: Idan a=1, to b=3, c kuma =−10 sun kayyadu. Wannan yana nuna tsarin cewa da zarar an kayyade ma'auni ɗaya, sauran suna biyo baya.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.explain: Idan mafita su ne 2 da −5, to (a, b, c)=(a, 3a, −10a). Idan c=−10a=−10, to a=1; idan a=1, to (1, 3, −10); idan a+b+c=a+3a−10a=−6a=−6, to a=1. Dukansu sun tilasta a=1. Sharadin a ya zama tabbatacce yana barin a=1, 2, 3 ...; kuma an riga an san cewa jimillar mafita biyu −3 ce da cewa duk ƙofofin ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka ba za su ƙara takaita lissafin ba.

z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b cikakkun lambobi ne da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
z-m-19-01.title: Shin √a+√b daidai yake da √(a+b)?
z-m-19-01.topic: A wane fasali za a iya rubuta jimillar lambobi biyu masu tushen murabba'i?
z-m-19-01.goal: Ka nuna da misalin ƙaryatawa guda ɗaya cewa ‘√a+√b=√(a+b)’ ba ya aiki koyaushe. Ka nemo nau'i-nau'i (a, b) da kanka inda jimillar tushen murabba'i biyu take sauƙaƙawa zuwa tushen murabba'i guda, sannan ka bayyana kamanninsu da kalmomi.
z-m-19-01.material: Minjae ya ce, ‘Don rubuta jimillar tushen murabba'i biyu, kawai a tara lambobin da ke ƙarƙashin alamomin tushen, a rubuta su a ƙarƙashin tushe guda. Misali, √2+√3 = √5.’ A ƙasa, a da b duk lambobi tabbatattu ne, kuma ikirarin Minjae shi ne ‘√a+√b=√(a+b)’ (tushen a da tushen b daidai yake da tushen jimillar a da b). Bayani: √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236.
z-m-19-01.thinking.0: Gwada ikirari da takamaiman lambobi da fahimtar ƙarfin misalin ƙaryatawa guda ɗaya
z-m-19-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalai da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan da gano tsarin kamanceceniya
z-m-19-01.thinking.2: Faɗaɗa da kalmomi kamanceceniyar da aka lura
z-m-19-01.prereq.0: Ma'anar tushen murabba'i da √a×√b=√(ab) (matakin aji na 9)
z-m-19-01.prereq.1: Nemo kimar kusan ta tushen murabba'i da kalkuleta
z-m-19-01.s.s1.prompt: Domin gwada ikirarin Minjae, mun saka a=9, b=16. √9=3 da √16=4, saboda haka √9+√16=7, kuma √(9+16)=√25=5. Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa wajen fassara wannan sakamako?
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka lissafta √9+√16 da √(9+16) dabam-dabam, ka rubuta su gefe da gefe, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin misalai nawa da ba su aiki ake buƙata domin ikirarin ‘yana aiki ga dukkan a, b’ ya zama ƙarya.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.a: Wannan hali ɗaya ne kawai bai yi daidai ba, amma da alama zai yi aiki ga sauran a, b
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.a: Ikirarin ‘ga dukkan a, b masu kyau’ misali guda ɗaya da bai yi aiki ba yana karyata shi. Ɗaukar ɗaya a matsayin keɓantacce yana nufin sauya ikirarin zuwa ‘yawanci daidai ne.’
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.b: Dole ne a nemo wasu misalai da dama, a ci gaba da samun kuskure kafin a ce ikirarin ba daidai ba ne
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.b: Domin nuna ikirari daidai ne, yawan misalai ba zai taɓa isa ba, amma domin nuna ba daidai ba ne, misalin ƙaryatawa guda ɗaya ya isa. Kana ɗaukar lokuta biyun a hanya ɗaya.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.c: 7 da 5 sun bambanta, saboda haka wannan ikirari ba ya aiki ga dukkan a, b masu kyau
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.d: 9 da 16 cikakkun murabba'ai ne, na musamman ne, saboda haka ba za a yi amfani da wannan gwajin a matsayin hujja ba
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.d: Ikirarin ya ce ‘a, b masu kyau’, don haka cikakkun murabba'ai ma suna ciki. Watsi da gwaji saboda ƙimomin sun yi kama da na musamman yana ba ka damar guje wa misalin ƙaryatawa.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.explain: Idan ikirarin ya ce ‘koyaushe’, misali guda ɗaya da bai yi aiki ba (√9+√16=7, √25=5) ya isa ya karyata shi. Amma wannan yana nufin kawai ‘wannan ikirari ba koyaushe yake daidai ba’, ba yana nufin babu jimillar da za a iya rubutawa a matsayin tushen murabba'i guda ba. A mataki na gaba za mu nemo irin waɗannan lokuta.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.prompt: Hanyar Minjae ba daidai ba ce, amma akwai lokutan da √a+√b take sauƙaƙawa zuwa fasali guda p√m (p da m lambobin halitta ne). Nemo nau'i-nau'i daban-daban guda 3 irin wannan. Sharuɗɗa: a da b lambobin halitta ne, 2≤a<b≤200, kuma a da b duka ba cikakkun murabba'ai ba ne (1, 4, 9, 16 ...).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka zaɓi kowane nau'i-nau'i, kamar a=5, b=7, ka nemo jimillar da kalkuleta, sannan ka bincika ko ƙimar idan aka raba da √5 lambar halitta ce.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka rubuta wasu nau'i-nau'i masu aiki gefe da gefe, sannan ka duba alaƙar a da b (ƙimar da aka samu ta ƙara, ninkawa ko rabawa).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne su zama lambobin halitta masu 2≤a<b≤200.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c2: a da b duka ba cikakkun murabba'ai ba ne.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c2: a ko b cikakken murabba'i ne. Sauya shi zuwa lambar da ba cikakken murabba'i ba ce.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c3: √a+√b yana sauƙaƙawa zuwa fasali guda p√m.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimillar wannan nau'i-nau'i ba ta sauƙaƙawa zuwa tushen murabba'i guda ba. Ka rubuta √a da √b kowannensu a mafi sauƙin fasalinsa gefe da gefe, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, √2+√8=√2+2√2=3√2, √3+√12=√3+2√3=3√3, √12+√27=2√3+3√3=5√3. Za a iya haɗa su su zama guda ɗaya ne kawai idan lamba ɗaya ta rage ƙarƙashin tushen bayan an sauƙaƙa gwargwadon iko. Ga irin waɗannan nau'i-nau'i, a×b cikakken murabba'i ne (2×8=16, 3×12=36, 12×27=324). Akasin haka, idan lambobin da suka rage sun bambanta, kamar √5+√7, ba za a iya haɗa su su zama tushen guda ɗaya ba.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Wane abu ne iri ɗaya a cikin nau'i-nau'i da ka samo? Ka kuma saka lambobi ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa ma'aunin Minjae √a+√b=√(a+b) bai yi aiki ba ga ɗaya daga cikin nau'i-nau'i da ka samo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ga ɗaya daga cikin nau'i-nau'i da ka samo, ka rubuta a da b kowannensu a matsayin (lambar halitta)×√(ƙaramar lamba).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka nemo ƙimomin kusan √a+√b da √(a+b) da kalkuleta, sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika ko kamanceceniyar da ka ambata tana aiki da gaske ga dukkan nau'i-nau'i da ka samo kuwa?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna cewa ma'aunin Minjae ba daidai ba ne ta hanyar kwatanta ƙimomi biyu (jimillar da √(a+b)) kuwa?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Ga (2, 8), √8=2√2, saboda haka √2+2√2=3√2. Wannan nau'i-nau'i ne inda lambobin da ke ƙarƙashin tushen suka zama iri ɗaya bayan sauƙaƙawa. Amma √(2+8)=√10≈3.16 ne, 3√2≈4.24 ne, don haka ƙimomin sun bambanta kuma ma'aunin Minjae bai yi aiki ba.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan aka duba (3, 12) da (12, 27), ninkar a da b cikakken murabba'i ne, kamar 3×12=36 da 12×27=324. Misali, √3+√12=3√3≈5.20, amma √15≈3.87, saboda haka ba su yi daidai ba.

z-m-19-03.title: Me ke faruwa da mafi ƙarancin ƙima idan zangon x ya canza?
z-m-19-03.topic: Mafi girma da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aikin quadratic idan zangon x yana da iyaka
z-m-19-03.goal: Idan aka ba da sabon zangon x, ka riƙe ko ka gyara hukuncinka game da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aikin quadratic, sannan ka ƙirƙiri zangon da ƙulli yake wajen zangon kuma ka nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙimar.
z-m-19-03.material: Doha ta sake rubuta aikin quadratic y=x²−4x+1 a matsayin y=(x−2)²−3, ta ce, "Mafi ƙarancin ƙima −3 ce." Amma zangon ƙimar x yana iya canzawa bisa ga tambaya. A kowane mataki ana nuna sabon zangon (kamar x ya fi ko ya yi daidai da 3 kuma bai wuce 6 ba) da teburin ƙimar y da aka samu daga wasu ƙimar x. Ka yi la'akari da dukkan ainihin ƙimomin x da ke cikin zangon.
z-m-19-03.thinking.0: Riƙe ko gyara hukunci bisa ga sabon bayani
z-m-19-03.thinking.1: Raba misalai bisa ko ƙulli yana cikin zangon ko a wajensa
z-m-19-03.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri zangon da ya cika sharuddan da kanka, sannan ka duba ƙimar
z-m-19-03.prereq.0: Karanta ƙullin da gatarin daidaiton aikin quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q (matakin aji 9)
z-m-19-03.prereq.1: Saka ƙimar x a cikin furuci domin nemo ƙimar y
z-m-19-03.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki, ka yanke hukunci ko furucin Doha 'mafi ƙarancin ƙima −3 ce' ya dace, bisa zangon x.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duba a wace ƙimar x ne mafi ƙarancin y a teburin yake faruwa, sannan ko wannan x yana cikin zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.1: Saka x da ba ya cikin teburin (misali 2.5 ko 3.5) cikin furucin, ka gwada ko yana ba da ƙima ƙasa da ta teburin.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Zango: dukkan ainihin ƙimomin x. Furuci: y=(x−2)²−3. Teburin ƙimomi (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mene ne mafi ƙarancin ƙimar wannan aiki?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.after: (x−2)²≥0, saboda haka y≥−3, kuma idan x=2, y=−3. A teburin ma mafi ƙarancin ƙima ita ce −3 lokacin x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka zaɓi ƙimar da ke ƙarshen teburin. Kwatanta inda mafi ƙarancin y a duk teburin yake.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka tsaya kusa da x=1 ko x=3. Kwatanta da ƙimar x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ko da x na iya zama kowace ainihin lamba, (x−2)² ba ya raguwa ƙasa da 0. Duba ko ƙimar tana ci gaba da raguwa ba tare da iyaka ba.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon sharadi: zangon x ya canza zuwa 0≤x≤5. Teburin ƙimomi (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zangon ya ƙanƙanta. Me za ka yanke game da mafi ƙarancin ƙima?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.after: x=2 yana cikin zangon, don haka −3 har yanzu yana samuwa; kuma saboda siffar furucin, (x−2)²≥0, ko x wanda ba ya cikin teburin ba zai rage ƙimar ƙasa da −3 ba. Duk da sabon bayani hukuncin zai iya nan yadda yake. Faɗin cewa 'yana da wuya a tabbatar daga teburin kaɗai' ma taka-tsantsan ne mai ma'ana.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ya kasance −3. x=2 yana cikin wannan zangon
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ya canza. Mafi ƙarancin ƙima y=1 ne a gefen hagu na zangon, x=0
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin idan zangon ya canza, ƙimar ƙarshen zangon ce za ta zama mafi ƙaranci. Duba ko ƙimar x=2 tana cikin zangon a teburin.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yana da wuya a tabbatar daga teburin kaɗai. Ƙimar x da ba ta cikin teburin na iya zama ƙasa da −3
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ya canza. Mafi ƙarancin ƙima y=6 ne a gefen dama na zangon, x=5
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka zaɓi ƙimar gefen dama. Kwatanta da mafi ƙarancin ƙima a teburin.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sabon sharadi: zangon x ya canza zuwa 3≤x≤6 (x=2 na ƙulli ba ya cikin wannan zango). Teburin ƙimomi (x → y): 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6, 6 → 13.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mene ne mafi ƙarancin ƙima a wannan zangon?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.after: x=2 yana wajen zangon, don haka −3 ba zai samuwa ba. A cikin zangon y yana ƙaruwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, don haka mafi ƙarancin ƙima −2 tana faruwa a ƙaramin x na hagu, x=3.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan ita ce ƙimar x=2. Duba ko wannan x yana cikin zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan ita ce ƙimar tsakiyar teburin. Sake duba inda mafi ƙarancin y yake.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka zaɓi mafi girman ƙimar teburin. Sake duba mene ne mafi ƙarancin ƙimar.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.reflect: Hukuncin farko, 'ƙimar y a ƙulli ita ce mafi ƙaranci,' daidai ne kawai idan x na ƙulli yana cikin zangon. Kamar mataki na 2, hukuncin zai iya nan yadda yake ko da sabon bayani ya zo; kamar mataki na 3, dole ne a gyara hukunci idan sharadin ya canza. Muhimmin abu shi ne a duba abin da ya canza (ko ƙulli yana cikin zangon ko a wajensa) sannan a yanke shawarar riƙe ko gyara hukuncin.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.prompt: Ga y=x²−4x+1, saita zangon x a matsayin p≤x≤q (p, q lambobi cikakku ne, −4≤p<q≤8) ta yadda x=2 na ƙulli ya kasance a wajen zangon. Ka kuma rubuta mafi ƙarancin ƙimar m a zangon. Ƙirƙiri zanguna 2 dabam.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.0: Alama a kan layin lamba wane gefen 2 ne p da q za su kasance domin zangon kada ya haɗa x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo ƙimar y a x biyu na ƙarshen zangon da ka zaɓa, ka duba ko ƙaramin cikinsu ya yi daidai da m.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p da q dole su zama lambobi cikakku masu −4≤p<q≤8.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.ok.c2: x=2 na ƙulli yana wajen zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c2: x=2 yana tsakanin p da q. Canza zangon don kada ya haɗa 2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.ok.c3: m ita ce mafi ƙarancin ƙimar wannan zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c3: m ba daidai ba ce. Nemo ƙimar y a ƙarshen zangon biyu ka kwatanta su.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.explain: Idan x=2 na ƙulli yana wajen zangon, y yana canzawa ta alkibla ɗaya kawai a cikin zangon. Saboda haka mafi ƙarancin ƙima tana faruwa a ƙarshen da ya fi kusa da 2. Misali, 3≤x≤6 yana ba da −2 lokacin x=3; −3≤x≤0 yana ba da 1 lokacin x=0; −4≤x≤1 yana ba da −2 lokacin x=1. Babu ɗaya da ke ba da −3.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.prompt: Ga wani aiki y=−(x−1)²+4, kana son nemo mafi girman ƙima idan zangon x shi ne −2≤x≤0. Wane abu ne ya dace a fara dubawa?
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.0: Alama −2, 0 da x=1 na ƙulli a kan layin lamba.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda wurin da mafi girman ƙima ke faruwa yake bambanta, bisa ko x na ƙulli yana cikin zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.a: Nan take ka rubuta 4, ƙimar y ta ƙulli (1, 4), a matsayin mafi girman ƙima
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.a: Ba ka duba ko x na ƙulli yana cikin zangon ba. Wannan matsala ɗaya ce da dalilin da ya sa −3 bai samu a matakin baya ba.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.b: Nemo ƙimar y a ƙarshen zangon biyu x=−2 da x=0, sannan ka zaɓi mafi girma
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.b: A wannan aikin da zangon, wannan hanyar tana ba da amsa iri ɗaya, amma tana iya rasa ƙimar ƙulli idan ƙullin yana cikin zangon.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.c: Jadawalin yana buɗewa zuwa sama, don haka fara nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙima
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.c: Ana tambayar mafi girman ƙima, mai yiwuwa ka gauraya dangantakar alkiblar lanƙwasa da mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.d: Da farko duba ko x-coordinate na ƙulli, 1, yana cikin zangon −2≤x≤0
z-m-19-03.s.s3.explain: x=1 ba ya cikin −2≤x≤0, don haka 4 na ƙulli ba ita ce mafi girma ba. A cikin zangon y yana ƙaruwa idan x ya ƙaru, saboda haka mafi girma ita ce y=3 lokacin x=0, yayin da x=−2 take ba da −5. Idan ƙulli yana cikin zangon, ƙimarsa zaɓi ce; idan yana waje, ƙimomin ƙarshen zangon ne zaɓuɓɓuka.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.acc.0: A wannan aikin da zangon, x=1 na ƙulli yana wajen zangon, saboda haka kwatanta ƙarshen biyu ma yana ba da amsa iri ɗaya, 3. Amma a wasu tambayoyin da ƙulli ke cikin zangon, za ka iya rasa ƙimarsa, don haka al'adar fara duba inda ƙulli yake ta fi aminci.

z-m-19-04.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da ya kuskure a mafita
z-m-19-04.title: Shin kusurwoyin da aka rubuta a cikin da'ira a kan baka masu tsayi iri ɗaya ne?
z-m-19-04.topic: Kusurwar da aka rubuta a cikin da'ira da tsawon baka: kusurwoyin baka masu tsayi iri ɗaya
z-m-19-04.goal: Nemo layin da kuskure ya fara a cikin bayanin 'idan tsawon baka ya yi daidai, kusurwoyin da aka rubuta a ciki sun yi daidai,' nemo kusurwoyin baka masu tsayi iri ɗaya a da'irori masu radius dabam, sannan ka bayyana sharadin da furucin zai tabbata.
z-m-19-04.material: Da'ira O tana da radius 6 cm, da'ira O' (O-prime) kuma radius 12 cm. Baka AB a da'ira O da baka CD a da'ira O' duka tsawonsu 4π cm ne, kuma kowace baka ta fi rabin da'ira ƙanƙanta. Doyun ya ce, "Kusurwoyin da aka rubuta a kan baka masu tsayi iri ɗaya ne," ya bayyana kamar haka. (Kusurwar da aka rubuta ∠APB ita ce kusurwar da wurin P a kan da'irar, a gefen da ba baka AB ba, yake kallon A da B; ∠CQD ma haka take. Ana karanta ∠APB da 'kusurwar APB'.)
z-m-19-04.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai na lamba da dama domin ganin tsarin misalin da ke karyata furuci
z-m-19-04.thinking.2: Faɗi sharadin da furuci zai tabbata
z-m-19-04.prereq.0: Girman kusurwar da aka rubuta a kan baka rabin girman kusurwar tsakiya ce a kan wannan baka (matakin aji 9)
z-m-19-04.prereq.1: Tsawon baka 2πr×(x/360) idan kusurwar tsakiya x° ce a da'irar radius r (matakin aji 7)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a bayanin Doyun da ba za a amince da shi ba. (Zai fi kyau a zaɓi layin farko da ya yi kuskure, amma za ka iya zaɓar layin da ya rubuta sakamakon kuskure saboda wannan.)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko kowane layi yana biyo kai tsaye daga layin da ya gabata, kuma kula ko radius na da'irorin biyu iri ɗaya ne ko dabam.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Yi lissafi dabam don nemo adadin digiri na kusurwar tsakiya ta baka mai tsawon 4π a kowace da'ira, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.0: Da'ira O tana da radius 6, da'ira O' radius 12, kuma bakunan AB da CD duka tsawonsu 4π ne.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.1: Tsawon bakunan iri ɗaya ne, don haka girman kusurwoyin tsakiya na bakunan biyu ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.2: Kusurwar da aka rubuta a ciki rabin kusurwar tsakiya ce, don haka ∠APB da ∠CQD ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka kusurwoyin da aka rubuta a kan bakuna masu tsayi iri ɗaya koyaushe iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Layin farko da kuskure ya fara shi ne layi na 2. Radius da kusurwar tsakiya ne tare suke ƙayyade tsawon baka, saboda haka a da'irori masu radius dabam, ko tsawon bakunan ya yi daidai, kusurwoyin tsakiya sun bambanta. A da'ira O, 4π=2π×6×(x/360) yana ba da kusurwar tsakiya 120°; a O', 4π=2π×12×(x/360) yana ba da 60°. Don haka kusurwoyin da aka rubuta sun bambanta: 60° da 30°. 'Kusurwar da aka rubuta rabin kusurwar tsakiya ce' a layi na 3 gaskiya ce, amma tana amfani da sakamakon kuskuren layi na 2, saboda haka ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne, haka ma layi na 4. Layi na 1 sharadin da aka bayar ne, ba shi da matsala.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: A da'irar radius r cm akwai baka mai tsawon 4π cm (rabin da'ira ko ƙasa). Nemo kusurwar da aka rubuta θ (digiri) a kan wannan baka, sannan ka ƙirƙiri da'irori 3 masu radius dabam. (r yana daga 4 zuwa 30; rubuta r da θ a matsayin ainihin ƙimomi.)
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo kusurwar tsakiya ta baka mai tsawon 4π a da'irar r=6, sannan ka samo kusurwar da aka rubuta daga gare ta.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta r da θ a tebur, sannan ka duba ko samfur ko jimillar ƙimomin biyu ce take kasancewa ɗaya.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: r dole ya kasance daga 4 zuwa 30.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Ita ce kusurwar da aka rubuta da ta dace da tsawon baka 4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kusurwar tsakiya ita ce 2θ. Duba ko tsawon baka 2πr×(2θ/360) ya zama 4π. Zaɓi r da zai ba da ainihin ƙima, ba kimantawa ba.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: Kusurwar tsakiya 2θ ce, saboda haka tsawon baka 2πr×(2θ/360)=πrθ/90. Idan wannan ya zama 4π, to rθ=360. Idan r=6, θ=60; idan r=12, θ=30; idan r=9, θ=40; idan r=4, θ=90. Ko da tsawon baka iri ɗaya ne, radius mafi girma yana ba da ƙaramin kusurwar da aka rubuta.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana wa Doyun. Wane ƙarin sharadi ake buƙata domin a ce kusurwoyin da aka rubuta a kan bakuna biyu masu tsayi iri ɗaya ne? Kuma me ya sa suke daidaita a ƙarƙashin wannan sharadin?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Duba ƙimar θ idan r ɗaya ne a teburin s2.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wanne daga tsawon baka, radius, da kusurwar tsakiya ne dole ya zama iri ɗaya domin kusurwoyin da aka rubuta su yi daidai.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka duba cewa sharadin da ka rubuta yana kawar da dukkan misalan s2 da ka ƙirƙira (da'irori masu radius dabam)?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana 'me ya sa suke daidaita' dangane da kusurwar tsakiya?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: Dole ne bakunan biyu su kasance a da'ira ɗaya (ko da'irori masu radius iri ɗaya). Idan radius ɗaya ne, tsawon baka iri ɗaya yana nufin kusurwar tsakiya iri ɗaya ce; kusurwar da aka rubuta kuma rabin kusurwar tsakiya ce, don haka su ma sun yi daidai.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.1: Ana buƙatar sharadin radius ya zama iri ɗaya. Idan sun bambanta, kamar 6 da 12, kusurwoyin tsakiya sun bambanta, 120° da 60°, saboda haka kusurwoyin da aka rubuta 60° da 30° ne. Idan radius ɗaya ne, kusurwar tsakiya tana daidai da tsawon baka, don haka kusurwoyin da aka rubuta su ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Faɗin 'kusurwoyin tsakiya iri ɗaya ne' ma'ana ɗaya ce da 'tsawon bakunan iri ɗaya ne.'
